messages:
maria_gonzalez: Heads up — I was reconciling the AWS Marketplace statements for Jan+Feb and there are ~3 invoice offsets labeled 'reseller-credit' that don't match our internal reseller payout ledger. CSV attached. Anyone else seeing this?

alex_s: seen something like this last quarter too but smaller. Those offsets reduce the gross payout from AWS, right? :thinking_face:

maria_gonzalez: Correct. On the AWS side they net the invoice before sending funds. Our ledger shows the gross revenue and separate reseller pass-through credits, so payouts look off until we apply the same offsets. Need to map IDs.

billing-bot: Imported AWS statement CSV (aws_marketplace_2027_01_02.csv) into /billing/tmp. 3 untagged offsets found: OFF-3342, OFF-3343, OFF-3389.

jamie_ops: Are those offsets tied to committed reserved capacity or some marketplace sku? Could be the legacy Dedicated commitment program we ran in APAC.

raj_patel: Quick check: OFF-3342 and OFF-3343 reference product_code=redwood-dedicated-resv; OFF-3389 is product_code=marketplace-credit. Looks like two are commitment-level adjustments and one is an account-level promo.

alex_s: If two are commitment adjustments, they might be reconciliations for committed GPU usage we under-delivered? Did capacity autoscale down in Jan in eu-west-1 and trigger a commitment true-up?

jamie_ops: We had scheduled maintenance in eu-west-1 on 2027-01-12 that dropped available GPU hours for ~36h. Could be the cause. I can pull cluster provisioning logs and the autoscaler events.

maria_gonzalez: Please do. Finance needs the mapping before month close (COB Friday). If those two offsets are valid, we need to post journal entries to reflect netting; otherwise chase AWS.

raj_patel: I'll export reserved_instance_usage and marketplace_chargeback logs for Jan-Feb and correlate with commit IDs. Running: `aws athena start-query --query-string "SELECT * FROM marketplace_charges WHERE offset_id IN ('OFF-3342','OFF-3343','OFF-3389')"` and then will dump to /billing/recon/1790145678.

alex_s: tagging @aws_am now — we need case opened for OFF-3389 (promo-looking) because invoice description is vague. @aws_am can you confirm reason code? :point_up: (will paste case link once created)

billing-bot: Support case created: AWS-CASE-79241 for invoice inquiry (OFF-3389).

jamie_ops: Pulled autoscaler events and cluster health for eu-west-1: found an outage window 2027-01-12T02:00 -> 2027-01-13T14:00 where many dedicated pools drained and we failed over to spot/dedicated fallback. I think that's the commit true-up root cause. Sending logs to /eng-infra/ops-exports/marketplace-offsets/1790145678.zip

maria_gonzalez: Good — that helps. Once raj finishes the raw mapping we can decide whether to book an adjustment or dispute. Also check whether any credits were applied to our reseller partner account vs our primary account — that was an edge case last year.

raj_patel: Done with correlation. OFF-3342 -> commit_id CMT-8821 (eu-west reserved pool shortfall), OFF-3343 -> CMT-8822 (same cluster, different AZ). OFF-3389 not linked to any commit_id. Put CSV with mappings in /billing/recon/1790145678/mapping.csv

alex_s: So two offsets are operationally valid. For OFF-3389 we need AWS confirmation and to check if it's promotional or an erroneous manual adjustment. If AWS confirms promo, we leave it; if erroneous, request reversal.

maria_gonzalez: Action items: 1) raj — prepare journal adjustment draft for the two commit offsets (include supporting logs). 2) jamie — escalate any infra RCA notes into the incident ticket and mark the maintenance that caused the shortfall. 3) alex — follow up with AWS AM on OFF-3389 and paste case update. Finance will hold the payout reconciliation until COB Fri.

jamie_ops: Will add RCA snippet: `root cause: scheduled maintenance + autoscaler drain + delayed pool reprovisioning -> committed hours underused` and estimate impact: ~1,120 GPU-hours short across the two AZs.

maria_gonzalez: Thanks all. If anyone finds additional mismatched offsets in GCP marketplace statements (we've had prior small diffs) please flag in this thread — we'll centralize. :white_check_mark:

alex_s: noted, i'll scan GCP statements as well and post findings here.

billing-bot: Reminder: month-close freeze in 48 hours.

maria_gonzalez: tagging final owner @finance for the journal once raj uploads the draft. We'll reconvene after AWS case update.

alex_s: ack."
